decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's waste-to-energy technology core, so under resource pressure and problemistic search it is the likeliest product to be cut and its resources redirected to core ventures.
Modular plant extensions complement the firm's WASTX plants at low added cost, so it can keep them as part of its system offering even though their results remain uncertain.
The WASTX Oil plant was launched with its own page and press release and fits the firm's decentralized waste-to-energy strategy, so management keeps it despite uncertain sales.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's core and identity, so management will carry it while aspirations and growing industry demand support continued development.
